question: Which wholly unmaterialized 3RScan family should receive the first fresh confirmation of a truth-free ambiguity trigger followed by one fixed local re-observation?

selection.ranking: Use unchanged metadata candidate order; exclude governed consumed targets, used reference families, and every candidate whose scans already have semseg, instance PLY, or sequence materialized. Select the first remaining row before pose, depth, RGB or model access; do not select on future triplet availability, ambiguity, proposal recall or action success.

post_download_gate.reference_memory: Require exactly three references under the unchanged positive-marginal plus maximum-angle vacancy rule.
post_download_gate.query_triplet: Among three-consecutive-frame runs of source-admitted target views, maximize minimum visible target vertices, then total visible vertices, minimum short-side fraction, minimum depth-visible ratio, then earlier frames. Freeze the first two as initial observations and the third as one fixed NEXT_FRAME_FORWARD action.
post_download_gate.same_scene_negative: Require one source-admitted different-instance door or doorframe in the rescan.
post_download_gate.truth_free_trigger: After materializing the unchanged scorer on the two initial frames, trigger exactly one NEXT_FRAME_FORWARD observation when the minimum per-frame Top-1-minus-Top-2 fused-score margin is at most 0.02. Never use IoU or target truth to trigger.
post_download_gate.source_is_evaluable_only_if: The reference rule yields three views, the query rule yields one consecutive triplet, and a same-scene sibling exists before RGB/model access.

literature_motivation.source: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
literature_motivation.use: Test a minimal deterministic local action before training random, farthest-point or MLLM policies.

literature_motivation.source: Active Perception for Ambiguous Objects Classification
literature_motivation.use: Trigger a new observation from ambiguity and judge whether that observation reduces candidate confusion.

forbidden_after_freeze: replace the selected family, target or six-file download plan
change view admission, reference vacancy fill, triplet selection, action direction, one-action budget, sibling rule or 0.02 trigger threshold
open RGB or run a model before source/triplet freeze
select or replace the family using future proposal recall, score margins, target IoU or action success
train RL/VLM, add another score, enlarge Top-3, or retune after the fresh result
claim_boundary: This freezes a twelfth family by metadata only. It is not source evaluability, RGB/model evidence, active-view confirmation, a deployable action policy, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
